atlas_note: Destrieux 2009 (aparc.a2009s) labels on fsaverage5, via nilearn.datasets.fetch_atlas_surf_destrieux. Every label is used in both hemispheres.
overlap_note: face_body shares G_oc-temp_lat-fusifor and S_occipital_ant with visual. Overlap is allowed: each group is averaged on its own. face_body has weight 0, so it is reported but does not count toward engagement.

visual.description: Occipital cortex: calcarine, cuneus, lingual, fusiform, lateral occipital, occipital pole.

auditory.description: Heschl's gyrus and sulcus, planum temporale, posterior lateral fissure, lateral superior temporal gyrus.

language.description: Inferior frontal gyrus (opercular, triangular), superior temporal sulcus, middle temporal gyrus, angular and supramarginal gyri.

attention.description: Dorsal attention network: intraparietal sulcus, superior parietal lobule, middle frontal gyrus, superior frontal sulcus, precentral sulcus.

face_body.description: Ventral and lateral occipito-temporal cortex: fusiform, inferior temporal gyrus and sulcus, lateral occipito-temporal sulcus, anterior occipital sulcus.

engagement.comment: engagement = 100 * sigmoid((raw - center) / scale). Fixed constants, NOT fitted per video, so scores are comparable across videos. Placeholder values: to be calibrated on a reference set of videos.

onset_correction.comment: TRIBE scores the first ~12 s of any video lower than the same footage placed mid-video (model warm-up, not content). Measured 2026-10-28: 5 reels, each re-analyzed starting 8-15 s in; points[i] = mean gap at second i (std 3.5-8.4). These points are added back to the engagement curve. Calibrated on short-form screen-recording reels with voice-over; other genres may differ.
